subdivision_of_building: The proposal affects the existing flat roof area above Flats 5 and Flat 6, creating an additional set-back fourth-floor level above Flat 6 with associated alterations to the existing roof structure.
decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.
description: ERECTION OF AN ADDITIONAL FOURTH-FLOOR ROOF EXTENSION, SET IN FROM THE ROOF EDGES, ABOVE THE EXISTING THIRD-FLOOR FLAT (FLAT 6) AT BAKERY HOUSE TO CREATE ADDITIONAL RESIDENTIAL ACCOMMODATION ASSOCIATED WITH FLAT 6, INCLUDING A NEW INTERNAL STAIRCASE FROM THE EXISTING UNIT, A SMALL ROOF TERRACE WITH GLASS BALUSTRADE, AND ASSOCIATED ALTERATIONS TO ELEVATIONS.
